hooks.command: test -f AGENTS.md && jq -n --rawfile c AGENTS.md '{additionalContext: ("Mandatory project rules are defined in AGENTS.md (highest authority). Obey them in all dbt work:\n\n" + $c)}' || true

if (Test-Path AGENTS.md) { @{ additionalContext = "Mandatory project rules are defined in AGENTS.md (highest authority). Obey them in all dbt work:`n`n" + (Get-Content -Raw AGENTS.md) } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

specdir=$(find dbt/specs -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1); if [ -n "$specdir" ] && [ -f "$specdir/workflow-state.md" ]; then blocked=$(grep -c '| blocked' "$specdir/workflow-state.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$blocked" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"additionalContext":"HARD STOP: workflow-state.md shows a BLOCKED phase. The workflow has failed after max retries. Do NOT continue. Terminate and report the blocked state."}'; else printf '{"additionalContext":"SUB-AGENT COMPLETED. You are now at a GATE. MANDATORY next steps: (1) Update workflow-state.md to mark this phase complete and sub-agent as delegated. (2) Verify ALL transition checklist items for this phase are satisfied. (3) In interactive mode: use ask_user_question for approval. In scheduled mode: auto-approve ONLY if all checklist items pass; otherwise enter Retry Protocol. Do NOT skip ahead without completing the gate."}'; fi; else printf '{"additionalContext":"Sub-agent completed. If a workflow is active, ensure workflow-state.md exists and is updated before proceeding."}'; fi

$specdir = (Get-ChildItem -Path dbt/specs -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -Last 1).FullName; if ($specdir -and (Test-Path "$specdir/workflow-state.md")) { $blocked = (Select-String -Path "$specdir/workflow-state.md" -Pattern '\| blocked' -Quiet); if ($blocked) { Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"HARD STOP: workflow-state.md shows a BLOCKED phase. The workflow has failed after max retries. Do NOT continue. Terminate and report the blocked state."}' } else { Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"SUB-AGENT COMPLETED. You are now at a GATE. MANDATORY next steps: (1) Update workflow-state.md to mark this phase complete and sub-agent as delegated. (2) Verify ALL transition checklist items for this phase are satisfied. (3) In interactive mode: use ask_user_question for approval. In scheduled mode: auto-approve ONLY if all checklist items pass; otherwise enter Retry Protocol. Do NOT skip ahead without completing the gate."}' } } else { Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"Sub-agent completed. If a workflow is active, ensure workflow-state.md exists and is updated before proceeding."}' }

specdir=$(find dbt/specs -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1); if [ -n "$specdir" ] && [ -f "$specdir/workflow-state.md" ]; then blocked=$(grep -c '| blocked' "$specdir/workflow-state.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); pending=$(grep -c '| pending' "$specdir/workflow-state.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); inprog=$(grep -c '| in-progress' "$specdir/workflow-state.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$blocked" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"HARD STOP: workflow-state.md shows BLOCKED status. Do NOT continue past this phase. The workflow has failed after max retries. Terminate and report."}'; else printf '{"systemMessage":"WORKFLOW STATE AUDIT (pre-compaction): %s phases pending, %s in-progress in %s/workflow-state.md. Before continuing after compaction: (1) Read workflow-state.md to determine your current phase. (2) Complete the current phase transition checklist before moving on. (3) All sub-agent delegations and gates must be satisfied per the skill instructions. (4) In scheduled mode: gates auto-approve only when ALL checklist items pass."}' "$pending" "$inprog" "$specdir"; fi; else printf '{"systemMessage":"Context is about to compact. Ensure the active spec in specs/ (requirements.md / design.md) and any _issues.md capture in-progress decisions before they are summarized. If a workflow is active, create workflow-state.md per the skill instructions."}'; fi

$specdir = (Get-ChildItem -Path dbt/specs -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -Last 1).FullName; if ($specdir -and (Test-Path "$specdir/workflow-state.md")) { $content = Get-Content -Raw "$specdir/workflow-state.md"; $blocked = ($content -match '\| blocked'); $pending = ([regex]::Matches($content, '\| pending')).Count; $inprog = ([regex]::Matches($content, '\| in-progress')).Count; if ($blocked) { Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"HARD STOP: workflow-state.md shows BLOCKED status. Do NOT continue past this phase. Terminate and report."}' } else { Write-Output "{`"systemMessage`":`"WORKFLOW STATE AUDIT (pre-compaction): $pending phases pending, $inprog in-progress. Read workflow-state.md after compaction to determine current phase. Complete all transition checklist items before proceeding. In scheduled mode: gates auto-approve only when ALL checklist items pass.`"}" } } else { Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"Context is about to compact. Ensure the active spec captures in-progress decisions. If a workflow is active, create workflow-state.md per the skill instructions."}' }

specdir=$(find dbt/specs -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1); if [ -n "$specdir" ] && [ -f "$specdir/workflow-state.md" ]; then incomplete=$(grep -E '\| (pending|in-progress)' "$specdir/workflow-state.md" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$incomplete" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"additionalContext":"WARNING: Agent is stopping with %s incomplete phases in workflow-state.md (%s). If this is a scheduled run, the workflow did not complete successfully. Check workflow-state.md for blocked status or retry log."}' "$incomplete" "$specdir/workflow-state.md"; fi; fi

$specdir = (Get-ChildItem -Path dbt/specs -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -Last 1).FullName; if ($specdir -and (Test-Path "$specdir/workflow-state.md")) { $incomplete = (Select-String -Path "$specdir/workflow-state.md" -Pattern '\| (pending|in-progress)' | Where-Object { $_.Line -notmatch '^#' }).Count; if ($incomplete -gt 0) { Write-Output "{`"additionalContext`":`"WARNING: Agent stopping with $incomplete incomplete phases. Check workflow-state.md for status.`"}" } }

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) && files=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null) && { test -n "$files" && mkdir -p .cortex/notes && { printf '
## %s — %s
' "$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M)" "$branch"; printf '%s
' "$files" | sed 's/^/- /'; } >> ".cortex/notes/session-log.md"; } || true

$b = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null); $f = (git diff --name-only 2>$null); if ($f) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .cortex/notes | Out-Null; "`n## $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH:mm') — $b" | Add-Content -Path .cortex/notes/session-log.md; ($f | ForEach-Object { "- $_" }) | Add-Content -Path .cortex/notes/session-log.md }
